DIAGNOSIS READY: Schizoaffective Disorder, Depressive Type. 

I have noted your 4-month history of persistent sadness with sleep and appetite disturbances, alongside auditory hallucinations beginning 7 months ago. Given the significant functional impairment and duration of symptoms, this clinical picture strongly suggests a schizoaffective disorder rather than major depression with psychotic features or schizophrenia alone. Would you be willing to undergo a psychiatric evaluation and possibly imaging to confirm this?
